notes.title: Sniffer goes to Tokyo Game Show 2025
notes.content: [h2]🎌 Tokyo Game Show 2025[/h2][p]We’re excited to share that Tiny Nomads will be part of [b]Tokyo Game Show 2025[/b], taking place September 25–28 in Chiba, Japan. TGS is one of the largest video game expos in the world, uniting creators, players, publishers, and innovators from across the industry.[/p][h3]👃 Representing Sniffer's Delight[/h3][p]At the show, we’ll be presenting our debut game, [i]Nasal Nomad: Sniffer’s Delight[/i]. In Sniffer’s Delight you play as Sniffer, a runny nose with snotty legs & toes! Harness unlockable breathing and snot-related abilities to sneeze, sniff, and snot through the strange sewers of Scentropolis to restore order one smell at a time. Befriend quirky characters and find your way back to the surface where your human awaits.[/p][p]Our goal at Tokyo Game Show is not just to let more players experience Sniffer’s wild adventure, but also to connect with potential collaborators, publishers, investors, marketers, and researchers who share our vision for bold and unconventional games.[/p][h3]👋 Come Say Hi! [/h3][p]If you’re attending TGS, come say hello at Sweden Game Arena! Whether you want to try [i]Nasal Nomad: Sniffer’s Delight[/i], chat with us about the game’s development, or explore possible collaborations, we’d love to meet you.[/p][h3][b]See you in Tokyo, and check out our new trailer! With the features and mechanics! [/b]ːsteamhappyː[/h3][previewyoutube="_pjTStYrBQU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45151607/19e43247efd3294685a117beb65934680641ef9e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: “Sniffer’s Delight” Earns First Famitsu Spotlight at TIGS 2025!
notes.content: [p]We’re thrilled to share that [b]Famitsu[/b] featured [i]Nasal Nomad: Sniffer’s Delight[/i] (『鼻と花：スニファーの喜び』) in their April 5, 2025 TIFFS report. The article include:[/p][list][*][p][i]The game's innovative 3D action mechanics, like charge-jumping based on press length, stretchy nasal limbs for traversal and puzzle interactions, and recovery provided by fragrant flowers in the environment [url="https://www.famitsu.com/article/202504/38649"]ファミ通.com[/url].[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Our cheeky development philosophy: “Why can't a nose be the hero?” Famitsu’s author noted that, when explained, "even the most squeamish players just might be won over" [url="https://www.famitsu.com/article/202504/38649"]ファミ通.com[/url].[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]A tease of more to come, details on a playable demo, plus Famitsu’s note that the game will feature Japanese localization [url="https://www.famitsu.com/article/202504/38649"]ファミ通.com[/url].[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]This recognition from one of Japan’s most trusted gaming outlets is such a boost for our team, and for Sniffer’s journey to your Steam wishlist.[/p][p]If you're as curious as we are, [b]give the game a wishlist[/b], follow our updates, and stay tuned for demo news soon![/p][p][/p][p]🌟 [b]Read the full article : [/b][b][url="https://www.famitsu.com/article/202504/38649"]ファミ通.com[/url][/b][b] [/b][/p]

notes.title: Gotland Game Conference 2025
notes.content:
[h1]Tiny Nomads | GGC 2025[/h1]
We are going to [b]Visby[/b] as judges for [b]Gotland Game Conference 2025[/b]. Held at the game design campus that started the game development journey for Tiny Nomads.

We will attend as judges to play, review and score the game made by the university students of [b]Campus Gotland[/b]. We are very excited to come back, talk with the students and teachers, as well as experience the beauty of [b]Visby[/b] once again.

Will you be there? Reach out to us - Let's talk! [b]contact@tinynomads.studio[/b]

[h2]Where?[/h2]
[b]Visby, Gotland
Sweden [/b]

[h2]When?[/h2]
[b]9-11th of June, 2025[/b]
